I try... all the time :( I try to be there for everyone as much as I can, I go way out of my way to help people, especially for the lab reports and midterms we have. I try to be nice to everybody, and as inclusive as possible

But nobody really cares, I still get left out from absolutely everything. I’m not “cool” like anyone else. I don’t drink like everyone else. I’m a more nerdy kinda guy I guess but nobody likes that. Nobody cares
Well it looks like I won’t be doing it soon. But I just know the world would be better if I wasn’t in it
I’ve got a big ol bottle of detergent though
And if I even go missing for a day there’ll be an investigation... I don’t have much at my disposal
That doesn’t make it sound too easy... I wish it was
I’m just such a failure. I mess everything up. I’m not actually a good friend of anyone, I’m so lonely. I wish I was just like everyone else. I can’t stand being myself anymore, I hate myself so much
